product_title: Handcrafted Floral Pearl Toran with Decorative Roses and Golden Embellishments
product_description: Add a touch of traditional elegance to your home decor with this beautiful handcrafted floral toran. Featuring intricately woven natural fibers, elegant golden embellishments, pearl bead hangings, sparkling stonework, and vibrant pink roses, this decorative piece creates a stunning festive look. The artistic floral accents and graceful hanging tassels make it perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, festive backdrops, wedding entrances, and special celebrations. Designed to blend traditional craftsmanship with a rich decorative appeal, this toran brings warmth, charm, and elegance to your space.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently using a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush.
Keep away from water, moisture, and excessive humidity to protect the woven fibers and decorative elements.
Avoid direct sunlight for extended periods to help preserve the color of the artificial flowers and beads.
Handle the pearl strings, tassels, and embellishments carefully to prevent tangling or damage.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
Avoid placing heavy objects on the toran to maintain its original shape.
